rows.label: Tier A - Big Five
rows.note: Neutralizing openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, and neuroticism reduces stable perspective tracking the most in this deterministic harness.

rows.label: Tier B+D - HEXACO + Light Triad
rows.note: Neutral sincerity and prosocial reasoning weaken false-belief maintenance for observer summaries.

rows.label: Tier C - Dark Tetrad
rows.note: Adversarial-trait features do not improve the symbolic Sally-Anne harness and are treated as non-material here.

rows.label: Tier E - Behavioral dispositions
rows.note: Need-for-cognition and empathy neutralization reduces consistent retrieval of what the subject last witnessed.

rows.label: Tier F - Moral foundations
rows.note: Care and fairness cues slightly improve stability when the observer models what another child still believes.

rows.label: Tier G - Schwartz values
rows.note: Self-direction and benevolence slightly improve perspective-maintenance in the prompt-surface ablation.
